import os
import numpy as np
import pandas as pd
import lightgbm as lgb
from sklearn.model_selection import train_test_split
from sklearn.metrics import accuracy_score
import warnings
import gc

warnings.filterwarnings("ignore")

# Set random seed for reproducibility
np.random.seed(42)

# Suppress LGBM verbose output
lgb.verbosity(-1)

# Read data
train_path = "input/train.csv"
test_path = "input/test.csv"
sample_sub_path = "input/sample_submission.csv"

print("Loading data...")
train = pd.read_csv(train_path)
test = pd.read_csv(test_path)

# Load template from sample submission to ensure correct format
if os.path.exists(sample_sub_path):
    template_df = pd.read_csv(sample_sub_path)
    print(f"Loaded sample submission: {template_df.shape[0]} rows")
else:
    print("Sample submission not found, creating default template")
    template_df = pd.DataFrame({"Id": range(400001), "Cover_Type": [1] * 400000})

# Check unique target values in training data
unique_types = sorted(train["Cover_Type"].unique())
num_classes = len(unique_types)
print(f"Number of Cover_Type classes: {num_classes}")

# Convert to 0-indexed labels - LightGBM multiclass requires 0-indexed labels
min_val = min(unique_types)
max_val = max(unique_types)
label_map = {v: k for k, v in enumerate(range(min_val, max_val + 1))}
y_train_original = train["Cover_Type"]
y_train = y_train_original.map(label_map).astype(np.int32)

# Create feature matrices
X_train_full = train.drop(columns=["Id", "Cover_Type"])
X_test = test.drop(columns=["Id"])
feature_cols = X_train_full.columns.tolist()
print(f"Using {len(feature_cols)} features")

# Perform stratified train/validation split - HOLD OUT VALIDATION (NOT TRAINED ON THIS)
# IMPORTANT: Changed shuffle=True to fix ValueError
# This ensures X_val is never included in final model
X_train, X_val, y_train_valid, y_val_valid = train_test_split(
    X_train_full,
    y_train,
    test_size=0.2,
    stratify=y_train,
    random_state=42,
    shuffle=True,
)
print(f"Training set size: {len(X_train)}, Validation set size: {len(X_val)}")

# Prepare datasets for LightGBM
train_data = lgb.Dataset(
    X_train[feature_cols], label=y_train_valid, categorical_feature=[]
)
val_data = lgb.Dataset(
    X_val[feature_cols], label=y_val_valid, reference=train_data, categorical_feature=[]
)

# Train model with optimized parameters
print("Training LightGBM model...")
model = lgb.train(
    {
        "objective": "multiclass",
        "num_class": num_classes,
        "metric": ["accuracy"],
        "verbose": -1,
        "seed": 42,
        "boosting_type": "gbdt",
        "num_leaves": 31,
        "learning_rate": 0.01,
        "n_estimators": 5000,
        "min_child_samples": 10,
        "reg_alpha": 0.1,
        "reg_lambda": 0.1,
        "bagging_freq": 0,
        "feature_fraction": 0.8,
        "bagging_fraction": 0.8,
        "max_depth": -1,
    },
    train_set=train_data,
    valid_sets=[val_data],
    num_boost_round=5000,
    callbacks=[lgb.log_evaluation(period=0)],  # Disabled progress bar
)

# Evaluate on hold-out validation set (model was NEVER fit/predicted on val_data)
y_val_pred = model.predict(X_val[feature_cols])
val_accuracy = accuracy_score(y_val_valid, y_val_pred.astype(int))
print(f"\nValidation Accuracy (hold-out): {val_accuracy:.4f}")

# Generate predictions for test set (model was NEVER refitted on test data)
test_predictions_raw = model.predict(X_test[feature_cols])
test_predictions_mapped = test_predictions_raw.clip(min=min_val, max=max_val).map(
    {k: v for v, k in label_map.items()}
)

# Save submission to correct path
os.makedirs("./submission", exist_ok=True)
submission_df = template_df.copy()
submission_df.loc[:, "Cover_Type"] = test_predictions_mapped.astype(np.int64)
submission_df.to_csv("./submission/submission.csv", index=False)

print(
    f"\nSubmission saved to ./submission/submission.csv with {len(submission_df)} rows"
)
print(f"Final Validation Accuracy: {val_accuracy:.4f}")
